system.description:
Spend a Hope and take a moment to read the terrain, ruins, or streets around you. Make an Instinct Roll (12). On a success, the area within Far range becomes your Surveyed Route until the scene ends or you take severe damage.

While you are within your Surveyed Route:
• You and allies within Close range can ignore difficult terrain while moving or driving.
• When you deal damage to an adversary in the zone, you can force them to mark 1 Stress.
• When you fail an action roll, you can end your Surveyed Zone to reroll your Duality Dice.
